work.cell_update_definition: stencil evaluations at unknowns: the unknown u and v faces (a_p > 0) once per outer iteration for momentum, plus the cells with a pressure equation (a_P > 0) once per five-point product of the conjugate gradient solve: one per iteration and one per true-residual check, at exit, at a restart and at the cap; the vector updates and the reductions are not counted, and neither are the multigrid V-cycle's own products and transfers, which a cycle forms on every level and which a row of staggered-cg has no counterpart of
